sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Sector breadth remains narrow with only 2 of 11 groups all-green, led by sustained dominance in Technology while Financials sharply lose ground.

Technology continues to spearhead overall market strength, remaining the sole sector to post sustained top-3 rankings across 1-, 3-, and 6-month timeframes alongside an elite momentum score of 0.933. While Energy holds the top YTD rank with solid 0.650 momentum, defensive-leaning sectors like Healthcare and Consumer Defensive are edging up the ranks. 

Conversely, Financials suffered the steepest drop over the past 5 sessions, sliding 3 spots to rank 8 with momentum dropping to 0.467. The bottom tier remains deeply entrenched in rate-sensitive and cyclical laggards, with Utilities and Consumer Cyclical anchored at ranks 10 and 11.

## Strength
- **Narrow Leadership:** Only 2 of 11 sectors maintain an all-green profile across all timeframes: Technology (momentum 0.93) and Communication Services (momentum 0.52).
- **Technology Anchors the Top:** Technology is the only sector demonstrating sustained strength across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons, holding the highest momentum score on the board at 0.933 (rank 2).
- **Commodity-Linked Strength:** Energy and Basic Materials both demonstrate robust top-tier momentum at 0.650 (rank 1) and 0.633 (rank 3), respectively.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Financial Deterioration:** Financials were the sole notable loser over the past 5 sessions, tumbling 3 spots to rank 8 with a momentum score of 0.467.
- **Defensive Up-Ticks:** Consumer Defensive (+1 to rank 6, momentum 0.42), Healthcare (+1 to rank 5, momentum 0.68), and Real Estate (+1 to rank 7, momentum 0.27) were the week's only rank gainers.
- **Deep Laggards:** Utilities (0.100 momentum, rank 10) and Consumer Cyclical (0.300 momentum, rank 11) remain firmly pinned at the bottom of the momentum rankings.

## Divergences
- **Communication Services Breadth vs. Rank:** Despite qualifying as one of only two all-green sectors, Communication Services sits low at rank 9 with middling momentum (0.52).
- **Healthcare vs. Cyclicals:** Healthcare is outperforming traditional economic bellwethers, securing the second-highest momentum score on the board (0.683) and moving up to rank 5, whereas Consumer Cyclical sits dead last at rank 11.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Market leadership remains anchored in tech hardware and precious metals, while a sharp short-term rotation is lifting Biotechnology and cyclical transport over fading defensive and financial groups.

Semiconductors (momentum 0.936) and Silver (0.936) continue to anchor broad market strength, supported by sustained high rankings across medium- and long-term windows. However, narrow breadth persists, with just 10 of 144 industry groups maintaining all-green profiles. Recent leadership is seeing an influx of healthcare and beat-up cyclicals, punctuated by Biotechnology climbing 28 spots to rank 26 and Airlines jumping 24 spots to rank 88. 

Conversely, defensive areas and consumer staples are losing ground. Telecom Services plunged 29 spots down to rank 101, alongside steep 5-day drops in Integrated Freight & Logistics (-21 spots) and Waste Management (-18 spots). Multiple high-momentum financial and energy segments are also flashing early fatigue, with groups like Oil & Gas Integrated and Diversified Banks beginning to bleed relative rank.

## Strength
- **Narrow leadership elite:** Only 10 of 144 industry groups are all-green across all timeframes, led by high-momentum standouts Semiconductors (0.936), Silver (0.936), Electronics & Computer Distribution (0.931), and Diagnostics & Research (0.887).
- **Persistent relative strength:** Semiconductors, Silver, Diagnostics & Research, Consumer Electronics, Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing, Steel, Internet Content & Information, and Marine Shipping have all sustained top-36 rankings across the 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons.
- **Hardware dominance:** Computer Hardware sits at rank 1 YTD with a 0.916 momentum score, flanked by Electronics & Computer Distribution at rank 3 YTD.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Biotech surge:** Biotechnology posted the largest 5-day advance, jumping +28 spots to rank 26 with strong 0.82 momentum.
- **Beaten-down rebounds:** Airlines (+24 spots to rank 88, momentum 0.63) and Uranium (+15 spots to rank 90, momentum 0.34) recorded significant rank jumps over the past week.
- **Sharp drop-offs:** Telecom Services experienced the steepest 5-session slide, tumbling -29 spots to rank 101 (momentum 0.24), followed by Integrated Freight & Logistics (-21 spots to rank 62, momentum 0.38).
- **Deepest laggards:** Gambling (0.052 momentum, rank 143 YTD) and Personal Services (0.094 momentum, rank 138 YTD) remain anchored at the bottom of the momentum spectrum.

## Divergences
- **Fading high-momentum pockets:** Several groups with solid momentum are rolling over in 5-day rank, including Insurance - Life (momentum 0.64, rank -10), Tobacco (momentum 0.60, rank -8), Oil & Gas Integrated (momentum 0.65, rank -6), and Banks - Diversified (momentum 0.66, rank -5).
- **Emerging low-momentum movers:** Early-stage rank jumps are appearing in deeply discounted pockets, including Uranium (+15 spots, momentum 0.34), Utilities - Renewable (+13 spots, momentum 0.36), and Apparel Retail (+11 spots, momentum 0.38).
- **Industrial turnarounds:** Aerospace & Defense improved +14 spots to rank 85 despite a middling momentum score of 0.51.
